advisory_ref: ACP Advisory to Shipping -- 2023 drought restriction sequence
note: Hand-transcribed (DECLARED), not scraped. During the 2023 El Nino drought the Panama Canal Authority progressively cut the maximum authorised draft on the Neopanamax locks from the normal 50.0 ft TFW down to 44.0 ft, and restored it through 2024. effective_to is deliberately BLANK because no superseding advisory has been transcribed into this table -- the consumer must treat any as_of after last_reviewed as UNKNOWN, never as 'no restriction in force'. Re-transcribe from the source_url and raise last_reviewed to make this table usable for a later date.
